author: DarkChii
what_it_is: At Viridian pokemon centre, with all tree starters at lvl 10, 999 rare candys, 999 masterballs, and heaps of cash.
format: SharkPort save ("SharkPortSave", kind 0x000F0000): title "POKEMON LEAF", date "1/09/2004 10:09:51 PM", notes ""; cart header "POKEMON LEAF" / 'BPGE' (complement 0x81); payload 65536 bytes; checksum: signed

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/gba-sharkport.py pokemon-firered-leafgreen-version.4855.sps --rom ROM --core CORE --outdir DIR: reads the SharkPort container as mGBA does and imports the payload as mGBA's _importSavedata does (cut to the chip, EEPROM 8-byte blocks reversed, the rest of the chip erased), then lays the chip out as the core keeps it

note: The GameShark copied only the first 64 KiB of the 128 KiB flash; imported as mGBA does, the second half of the chip stays erased. The game had saved once, into the second copy (flash sectors 14-27); the 64 KiB dump holds only two of its fourteen sectors, so there is no whole copy and every core starts a new game.
